Knowledge Economic City represents one of the economic development projects that were launched within the economic cities system in the Kingdom with the aim of supporting the national economy by creating distinct investment opportunities as well as establishing knowledge industries that work as a catalyst to create an additional commercial area within the great interest that the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia attaches to supporting growth.
